description.en: Possessing a character in a fictional story is one thing, but possessing a character in your own story is another… especially when you’ve become a dramatic villainess in a typical K-drama series. When our protagonist becomes the game character Jun Karentia, she thinks she has it made. She may be just a lowly support mage but with her knowledge of the game, she knows she can finagle her way to the good ending following around the main character, Fabian. The problem…? This game doesn't end after one playthrough. Jun is prepared to guide Fabian through the second playthrough to the true ending when… Fabian abandons her. Now Grand Duke Mayer Knox—captain of the Dark Knights and the secret final boss—is determined to have her join his party. Can Jun turn the final boss into the main character? Why is Mayer Knox so intent on having her at his party? And when will these rumours about being his lover stop?!

description.en:
When I came to, I found myself in the body of a notorious villainess—tasked with running a boarding school in a ruined reverse harem romance novel.
But this isn’t just any school.
It’s a secret facility where troubled noble boys are locked away, doomed to live out their lives hidden from the world.

“You’re the one who gave the order to knock me out earlier, aren’t you?”

And now, the first male lead has been dragged in right before my eyes.
I’m definitely in trouble.

To avoid getting killed by the male leads, I tried to be friendly—just enough to stay alive.
That was the plan.

“If it means protecting you, I’ll do anything.”
“It’s strange… I can’t stop wanting you.”
“Say you love me—before I completely lose control.”

Why are the male leads becoming obsessed with me instead of the heroine?

Getting more involved with them only puts my life in greater danger.
So, I made up my mind to quietly run away.

…Then why are they chasing after me?

description.en:
One day, I realized that I had been reincarnated as the friend of the female protagonist who dies trying to save the heroine of a decaying fiction novel.

I really wanted to tell the female lead about this, but for some reason, my words were muted, as if to prevent spoilers. Frustrated, I ended up going into the forbidden forest and shouting out the secret at the top of my lungs, even cursing the male lead: "The male lead is a bastard!"

But since no one was around to hear it, rumors later spread that the male lead, Archduke Wischwaltz, was actually gay. And now he's even investigating to find the source of this unfounded rumor...? "...My voice really struck a chord, didn't it?"

Looks like I've ruined my life.

description.en:
Sooha, who’d licked her lazily like a languid predator, tilted his head and tried to kiss her. Hyemin leaned her upper body back as much as possible. Sweat traveled down her spine.

As he continued, the sounds she heard outside made her nervous.

They can’t get caught. Never, at least for the sake of her life’s peace and serenity!

“A-At home.”

She bit her lips and whispered seriously as if trying to negotiate.
At that, his languid eyes briefly lit up.

“Home?”

“Yeah! I’ll discharge you from the hospital. So at home...”

“Let’s continue?”

Irritated, she pushed his shoulder. But in the end, she couldn’t slip out.

“No.”

He, who kissed her glistening lips repeatedly, smirked and placed his body over hers again.

“I don’t want to. I can’t wait, Honey.”

Song Hyemin is a fourth-year resident at Songlim University Hospital, facing the worst crisis of her life thanks to A-list celebrity Lee Sooha, who suddenly visited her.

My secretive and dizzying roommate story, as hazy as it is lovely.

Determined to change her fate, she runs to Leroy and boldly proposes:

description.en:
After my sudden death, I was reincarnated in a strange world with a sultan and his harem, but not as a person, but as a kitten who can't talk!

I can only become human by kissing a prince who is worthy of the sultan...

After mistaking me for an assassin and treating me coldly, Prince Soliman says, "......It's soft, it's warm, can we stay here for a while?" as he approached me.

Prince Theron, who I thought was a sweetheart, seduces me by whispering, "Choose me over my brother, and I will give you everything you want." "I will give you everything you want," he whispered, seducing me.

I can't stay human unless I kiss one of them. "Nyaaong!" (Headache!)
How do I survive in this royal palace?
description.fr:
Je me suis réincarnée dans un monde étrange avec des sultans et des harems. Mais le problème, c’est que je ne suis plus une humaine, mais un chaton qui ne sait pas parler! Il n’y a qu’une seule façon pour moi de redevenir humaine. Et c'est d’embrasser un prince qui est un sultan qualifié. D'ailleurs… Pourquoi tous les gens dans ce palais sont-ils si étranges?

===

 Prince Suleyman, qui m'a prise pour un assassin et m'a traitée avec indifférence:

«Je ne veux te donner à personne. Je te protègerai. Toi… tu es mon précieux chat.»

…et le prince Theron, que je trouvais doux, m'a parlé de manière obsessionnelle:

«Ne choisis pas mon frère aîné, s’il te plaît, choisis-moi. Je te donnerai tout dans ce royaume.»

Il m’a murmuré de si douces tentations à l’oreille. Je dois embrasser l'un d'eux pour conserver ma forme humaine.

«Miaou! (J'ai mal à la tête!)» Quel sera mon avenir ?
description.id: Setelah kematiannya yang mendadak, dia bereinkarnasi di dunia asing bersama seorang sultan dan harem. Lagipula, itu bahkan bukan manusia, melainkan anak kucing yang tidak bisa bicara! Katanya kamu bisa berubah menjadi manusia hanya dengan mencium seorang pangeran yang layak menjadi sultan... Pangeran Suleiman memperlakukan saya dengan dingin, salah mengira saya sebagai seorang pembunuh. “… … Lembut dan hangat. “Bolehkah aku tetap seperti ini sebentar?” Dia mendekatiku dan berkata, Pangeran Theron, yang menurutku baik, “Pilih aku, bukan saudaramu. “Aku akan memberikan semua yang kamu inginkan.” Dia berbisik dan menggodaku. Saya tidak dapat mempertahankan bentuk manusia saya kecuali saya mencium salah satu dari mereka. “Niaaoong!” (Kepalaku sakit!) Apa yang harus saya lakukan untuk bertahan hidup di istana ini?
description.ko:
갑작스러운 죽음 이후, 술탄과 하렘이 있는 묘한 세계에 환생했다.
하필이면 사람도 아닌 말 못 하는 아기 고양이로!
 
오직 술탄의 자격이 있는 왕자와 입을 맞춰야 인간으로 변할 수 있다는데…
 
나를 암살자로 착각하고 차갑게 대하던 슐레이만 왕자는
“……부드럽고, 따뜻해. 잠깐 이렇게 있어도 될까?” 라며 내게 다가오고.
 
다정한 줄만 알았던 테론 왕자는,
“형님 말고 저를 선택하세요. 당신이 원하는 모든 걸 바치겠습니다.” 라고 속삭이며 나를 유혹한다.
 
둘 중 하나와 키스하지 않으면 인간의 모습을 유지할 수 없는 나.
“냐아오옹!”(머리 아파!)
이 왕궁에서 살아남으려면 어떻게 해야 하지?
description.pl: Odrodziłam się i nagle znalazłam w dziwnym świecie sułtanów i haremów. Co gorsza, nie byłam już człowiekiem, lecz małym kociakiem, który nie potrafił mówić! Istniał tylko jeden sposób, żebym odzyskała ludzką postać – musiałam pocałować tego księcia, który stanie się prawowitym sułtanem. Książę Suleiman, który pomylił mnie z zabójczynią i traktował z obojętnością, powiedział: "Nie oddam cię nikomu. Będę cię chronił. Ty... Jesteś moim ukochanym kotem." Natomiast Książę Theron, którego uważałam za łagodnego, szepnął mi obsesyjnie do ucha: "Nie wybieraj mojego starszego brata, proszę, wybierz mnie. Dam ci wszystko co zechcesz w tym królestwie." Muszę pocałować jednego z nich, by pozostać człowiekiem. Jak będzie wyglądała moja dalsza przyszłość?
description.ru:
После внезапной смерти я переродилась в странном мире с султаном и его гаремом…
Вот только почему именно кошкой, которая даже говорить не умеет?!

Лишь поцеловав принца, я смогу превратиться в человека, но...

Принц Сулейман, приняв меня за наёмную убийцу, обращался холодно, и всё же…
«...Мягкая, тёплая. Можно я побуду так ещё минутку?»

А принц Терон, которого я считала ласковым и милым, вдруг начал меня соблазнять:
«Выбери меня вместо брата! Я дам тебе всё».

Я должна выбрать кого-то одного, чтобы поддерживать человеческую форму!

«Мяу!» (Как же болит голова!)
Как мне выжить в этом дворце?

description.en:
"I-I like you, professor."
"I think it's better for you not to do that."
"Ah, you're leaving tomorrow anyway. I know, I know it! That's why I wanted to tell it to you." 

Yoo Daon, a second-year resident of Korea University's Thoracic Surgery Department.

That night, when she made her last confession gathering the utmost courage that she ever had in her lifetime, saying she won't let her slave life end so pathetically, a wave of sorrow suddenly hits her.

"Youngest! Professor Kang didn't leave! He said that he's going to stay at the hospital!"

And that's how the second act of slavery in her life has begun. In order to solve the tragedy of an irreversible confession, she was appointed to become the assistant of the genius professor who holds the title as the youngest, shortest, best in all possible records.

"I think that confessing to the professor was a huge turning point in my life. I gained strength and courage. It's like b-bungee jumping, you know...?"
"So you used me as a bungee jumper?"
"Excuse me?"
"From what you said, a medical doctor who has only completed two years of residency is now jumping into her professor like it's beyond god's will." 

By the way, was the professor always been someone who could smile like this? This is the survival love story of the youngest thoracic surgeon who cannot be caught in love.


Sunset Corner synopsis :
"A love story between a surgeon and her professor."

한국대학교 흉부외과 2년 차 레지던트 유다온.

“막내야! 강 교수님 안 가신대! 그냥 우리 병원 있기로 했대!”

그렇게 시작된 노예 인생 제2막. 
돌이킬 수 없는 고백의 참사를 수습하고자 최연소, 최단, 최고,
모든 기록을 보유한 천재 교수님의 강제 어시스턴트로 낙점된다.

힘도 내고 용기도 얻고…… 버, 번지점프 하는 것처럼요!” 

“그래서 나를 번지점프대로 써먹었다?”

하늘 같은 교수한테 멋대로 뛰어들었다는 거네?” 

그런데 이 교수님, 원래 이렇게 잘 웃는 분이셨나? 
사랑인 듯 아닌 듯 종잡을 수 없는 흉부외과 막내(노예)의 러브 서바이벌.

description.en: What does "Mu" (武) in martial hero (武俠) mean? It is the power to enforce one's own sense of justice (俠). If that power extends beyond oneself, through others, and reaches the ends of the world, then that is the realm of the divine (神). What does a mere human need to ascend to godhood (入神)? Now begins the epic of Pi Wolryeo in search of that answer!

Wohn Ku is a vampire that needs human blood to survive.

As a tenderhearted child, she led a tortured existence until a girl named Seyeon willingly became her steady blood source. Seyeon stood by Wohn throughout their school years, defending her from bullies. 

Fast forward to the present where they move in together ahead of their freshman year of college. Seyeon remains fiercely protective of her friend, but Wohn is ready for a fresh start.

When a devoutly religious sophomore girl named Juyi showers her with kindness, Wohn emerges from her shell only to realize that Juyi had once been her father’s kidnapping victim, a potential blood source she had refused to bite. Juyi grows closer to Wohn without remembering the incident, fueling jealousy in Seyeon.

Will Juyi prove to be a savior washing away Wohn’s guilt, or will she ruin a vampire’s dream of redemption?

The ultimate moody emo villainess with skull decorations and black roses on everything she owns... The ultimate symbol of my dark and moody past - and now I am suddenly her?! description.en:
When I opened my eyes, I was a princess.

I was reborn as a princess, not a princess in Joseon, but a worldview far from actual history without any hard work to watch the historical drama. I was born as the daughter of a lowly concubine, so I just wanted to live a quiet life, but I can't, so...

I pushed out Youngbin and her son who were aiming for an empty midfield seat! And realized that this world is similar to the novels I've read before!

The fact that the final boss, no, the villain Youngbin and her son Kyung-eon-gun while I who had been in the extra 1st position, had somehow removed them!

Thanks to this, the Crown Prince who would otherwise have been killed is still alive, and the Grand Prince, who should have been distrusted as a Crown Prince after suffering a dark battle, is still intact!

I wonder if this is okay... It was far from the novel's content, but I wanted to live a peaceful and enjoyable life... Things in the world don't always go as planned.
___
After a fatal accident, Sia is transported into a historical drama as the baby princess of a lowly concubine. All she wants is to live peacefully with her new mother, but Sia's strength and intelligence gain her the favor of the crown prince and the king. Soon, she becomes a pawn in the hotly contested selection of the new queen. With the competing head concubines and their sons using her in their race to the throne, can baby Sia save herself from falling prey to this royal charade?

description.ru:
Проснувшись, я обнаружила себя принцессой. Перерождение свершилось – не в корейском королевстве Чосон, а в мире, лишь отдалённо напоминающем историческую реальность, словно декорация к забытому историческому сериалу. Дочь низшей наложницы, я мечтала лишь о тихой жизни, но судьба распорядилась иначе…

Я устранила Ёнбин и её сына, претендовавших на вакантное место наследника престола!

И тут я поняла: этот мир удивительно похож на романы, которые я читала прежде! Главная злодейка, Ёнбин, и её сын, Кёнъон-гун, – те самые финальные боссы, а я, бывшая лишь второстепенным персонажем, как-то невероятным образом устранила их!

Благодаря этому, наследный принц, которому была уготована смерть, остался жив, а великий князь, которому предстояло пасть жертвой дворцовых интриг, сохранил свою жизнь и положение!

Странно всё это… Мир сильно отклонился от канона романа, а я всего лишь хотела спокойствия и безмятежного существования… Но, увы, в жизни не всё идёт по плану.
description.pt-br:
Quando abri meus olhos, eu era uma princesa.

Eu renasci como uma princesa, não uma princesa, em Joseon, mas uma visão de mundo longe da história real sem nenhum trabalho duro para assistir ao drama histórico.

Eu nasci como filha de uma concubina júnior, então eu só queria viver uma vida tranquila, mas não posso, então...

Eu empurrei Youngbin e seu filho que estavam mirando em um assento vazio no meio do campo... !

E percebi que este mundo é semelhante aos romances que li antes!

O fato de que o chefe final, não, o vilão Youngbin e seu filho Kyung-eon-gun enquanto eu que estava na 1ª posição extra, de alguma forma os havia removido!

Graças a isso, o príncipe herdeiro que de outra forma teria sido morto ainda está vivo, e o grão-príncipe, que deveria ter sido desconfiado como um príncipe herdeiro depois de sofrer uma batalha sombria, ainda está intacto!

Eu me pergunto se isso está certo...
Estava longe do conteúdo do romance, mas eu queria viver uma vida pacífica e agradável...
As coisas no mundo nem sempre saem como planejado.

"Sim."

Para ser honesto, eu via meu pai biológico com bastante frequência.

O príncipe herdeiro Jawa, que é gentil, bonito e até um salva-vidas, mas é um tanto indiscutível.

"?"

O menino é legal, mas um pouco irritante até mesmo seu irmão mais velho, que tem seis anos de diferença.

Eu sei que é difícil para todos...
mas se você precisa de cura, crie um cachorrinho ou tenha um filho...

Nós iremos ver isso mais tarde."

Essa criança está flertando comigo agora?

“My uncle's mansion needs a maid, Elizabeth.”

The Old lord's mansion. There was no maid in the mansion to accommodate the lord. So, there will be only one purpose to make yourself the maid of the mansion! It is to serve at night!

description.en:
I met a friend who disappeared a few years ago, and it turns out he's now an exorcist?!

Jisang often speaks nonsense or acts dangerously out of nowhere, and sometimes experiences memory lapses. His friend and underclassman, Taeju, shares a concern that he has: When the club members enter the club room, they fall victim to strange phenomena.

Believing it to be the work of a ghost, Taeju calls an occult specialist to resolve the situation. Unexpectedly, the specialist turns out to be Jisang's childhood friend, Ham Leerae.

Jisang then learns that his symptoms weren't due to an illness, but were caused by spiritual possession. Determined to keep Leerae around, Jisang offers his body to assist with exorcism requests.

"That's how I can make you stay. So you can't escape now."

description.pt-br:
Acordei depois de jogar um jogo de criação de filhas. O problema é que eu me tornei a tia que vem intimidando a heroína há anos! Para piorar a situação, perdi o “jogador” que poderia tê-la salvado. Sair do jogo não era uma opção, tudo o que me restava era uma pilha de dívidas e a protagonista que eu tinha que criar. Para sair desse jogo, preciso criar bem minha sobrinha e ver o final. Então, um estranho misterioso aparece e me entrega uma proposta de casamento suspeita…

“Eu realmente nunca pensei em casamento antes. É muito precipitado.” “Você nem sequer me deu uma chance, está recusando imediatamente?” “Sou um pouco frio.” “Gosto disso em você, de ser frio.” Eden Bertenon, o Grão-Duque, um nome mencionado apenas no jogo, havia me pedido em casamento. Um homem que pede em casamento uma mulher que nunca viu antes, sem sequer olhar para ela. Embora eu não conseguisse entender suas intenções ou motivos, ele poderia ser uma pista para um final oculto.

“Está bem. Podemos ser um casal que pode se divorciar a qualquer momento mediante um acordo.” Foi um casamento por contrato em que prometemos o divórcio ao mesmo tempo em que fizemos a proposta. Eu tinha um marido racional. Achei que tudo o que restava era criar a heroína em segurança para ver o final…

description.en:
*I'll marry the male lead myself!*

Raffine is in a predicament, and there are three reasons why. One, she's been reincarnated into a super angsty, highly depressing novel. Two, her older brother is destined for death in said novel. And three, the only way to save him is by marrying the male lead. What the hell is going on?!

---
I possessed Raphine, the youngest sister of the second male lead, who had no dreams nor hopes, in an impoverished and obsession filled novel. That was also because he had a crush on the female lead, who married the male lead on a contract, and eventually died.

I can't believe it's such a miserable ending for my favorite character and kind eldest brother. No way!

Raphine decided to brainwash Prince Jerkan, the male lead of the novel, to prevent the female lead's contract marriage.

So that he can think of me when he needs a contract marriage!

"Jerkan! I want to marry you!"
"If you're grateful, you have to marry me next time."
"I need a simple marriage, so I'll get married through a contract."

And when the brainwashing finally succeeded, Raphine cheered inside.

"Okay. Definitely, I'll marry you."

I never imagined what kind of eyes he was had. Yeah, I really didn't know then. I didn't know this would happen.

"Didn't you pester me because you wanted to marry me?"
"Will you run away?"
description.pt-br: Eu possuí Raphine, a irmã mais nova do segundo protagonista masculino, que não tinha sonhos nem esperanças, em um romance empobrecido e cheio de obsessão. Isso também aconteceu porque ele tinha uma queda pela protagonista feminina, que se casou com o protagonista masculino e acabou morrendo. Eu não posso acreditar que é um final tão miserável para meu personagem favorito e irmão mais velho gentil. De jeito nenhum! Raphine decidiu fazer uma lavagem cerebral no Príncipe Zerkan, o protagonista masculino do romance, para evitar o casamento contratual da protagonista feminina. Para que ele possa pensar em mim quando precisar de um casamento por contrato! "Zerkan! Eu quero me casar com você!" "Se você está grato, você tem que se casar comigo na próxima vez." "Eu preciso de um casamento simples, então vou me casar por meio de um contrato." E quando a lavagem cerebral finalmente teve sucesso, Raphine aplaudiu por dentro. "Tudo bem. Definitivamente, eu vou casar com você." Nunca imaginei que tipo de olhos ele tinha. Sim, eu realmente não sabia até então. Eu não sabia que isso iria acontecer. However, when Arnell finds out that she can use the power of mana, she has a change of heart.

description.fr:

In Yikyung’s mind, Necromancy seemed like the ultimate mix of cool and interesting. Back then, he had no idea that the Necromancer class was the weakest of them all! But as Yikyung enters the newly reopened Tower of Spirits in search of enhancement materials, he is sucked into a mysterious area of the dungeon where he encounters a frightening corpse. “Ding!” A quest window pops up, and it says… “You have made a pact with Seo Dawon, a vengeful spirit.” When tackling quests, it doesn’t hurt to have a companion or two, especially if one of them is the spirit of an ultra powerful and handsome young man. After all, “it’s dangerous to go alone”!

Many people imagine living the life of a hero/heroine within their favorite fantasy novels. However, what if you wake up in the body of the main villain/villainess instead?

Our main character goes through a seemingly fatal air crash and wakes up in the body of Letisha de Arcadia, the main villainess within her favorite fantasy novel.

This is a story of survival.

“You are the only person I truly love.”
